The standing check the watcher dispatches
========================================

$ FM_HOME=<lab> bin/fm-hold-reverify.sh arm
  armed: state/hold-reverify.check.sh

state/ after arming:
  drwxrwxr-x 2 azureuser azureuser 4096 Sep 28 16:53 hold-reverify
  -rw------- 1 azureuser azureuser   84 Sep 28 16:53 hold-reverify.check-trust
  -rwx------ 1 azureuser azureuser  328 Sep 28 16:53 hold-reverify.check.sh

the shim bytes the watcher validates:
  #!/usr/bin/env bash
  # Auto-generated by fm-hold-reverify.sh - aged captain-hold re-verification.
  # The watcher validates these bytes, then dispatches the trusted check script.
  export FM_HOME=/tmp/fm-holdlab.oPm6Pq
  exec /home/azureuser/.no-mistakes/worktrees/6f716179fc56/01M3MDHAW7QHKHXPYCSEF6XHHZ/bin/fm-hold-reverify.sh check

the watcher's own dispatch path (bin/fm-check-lib.sh validation, then the
check run under FM_CHECK_TIMEOUT, exactly as bin/fm-watch.sh runs it):
  registered: the trust binding matches the shim bytes
  check exit: 0
  watcher wake -> check: state/hold-reverify.check.sh: hold re-verify: 0 dead, 0 still live, 0 not-a-decision, 12 unestablishable among 12 aged captain holds (35 deferred); docket state/hold-reverify/docket.json

$ FM_HOME=<lab> bin/fm-hold-reverify.sh disarm
